fields.accuracy: mean correct over n_scored; None when denominator empty
fields.auc: rank AUC over n_scored; None when a class absent
fields.auc_degradation_vs_baseline: same-predictor S0 in-domain AUC minus this cell AUC
fields.ece: expected calibration error over scored cases (10 equal-width bins)
fields.small_n_warning: true when n_scored < 100; such cells are exploratory
fields.stratum: S0 reference | S1 partial mappings | S2 unknown categories | S3 domain shift | S4 cold start | A1-A4 ablations

rules: ABSTAIN is never scored as 0; it is reported in n_abstain and coverage
NOT_APPLICABLE cases are excluded and reported; never imputed
empty denominator yields None, never a fabricated number
all cells carry measured provenance from runs/p04/reference_eval/leaderboard.json
unit: one row per (predictor, stratum, scenario) cell
